condition.help: Convective (Newton cooling) heat boundary: the conductive flux leaving the surface is h_c (T - T_ambient). Enter h_c = 0 for an insulated surface, which is also what leaving the boundary unset gives. Do not apply this and a prescribed temperature to the same entity - the two thermal boundary sets must be disjoint.

value.help: Surface heat transfer coefficient in W/(m2.K). Zero gives an adiabatic surface.
Temperature of the surroundings the surface exchanges heat with.
